entities.name: Poli Díaz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Policarpo "Poli" Díaz Arevalo is a Spanish former professional boxer who competed from 1986 to 2001. He held the European lightweight title from 1988 to 1991, and challenged for the unified WBA, WBC and IBF lightweight title in 1991.
